completionGate: Require actual collector exit 0, no COLLECTION-FAILED.json, a complete COMPLETED.json with validationComplete=true, matching manifest/index hashes, and every indexed payload hash. Manifest/index alone never assert success.

exactCorrection.reason: Opening actually says 至少完成10项. Original consumer omitted 完成 in its regex and failed before completing its first case. No application or build changes.

qualityBridge.scope: Unit/strict/build source and runtime are unchanged for the application. The one later helper regex change is preserved exactly; no unrelated unit/build rerun is claimed.

modelBridge.scope: Only existing archive file hashes and source/runtime dependency identities are checked here. No complete model journal replay is run by this collector.

replays.scope: Additional SDK validation of concrete output documents, including repeated historical/fixture copies and failed diagnostic states. No UI actions or whole-model sample is executed here.

toolCorrection.scope: Actual exec terminal observations; original failed attempt retained, then corrected evidence-tool assertion and successful isolated before observation. No production/model input modified.

attempts.failure: Evidence tool incorrectly expected zero coins after two genuine automatic raw-blade settlements; actual 60 correctly includes their 30+30 recovery. Failed before browser launch.

originalRuntimeBinding.note: This checks the preserved original HTTP receipt, without contacting 4179 during collection.
